title: Journey Book
body: Like the passing of a day, from a bright early morning beginning in Ithaca to a night ending in Marfa. Their notes and accords take you on a crescendo from softness to intensity. You will become acquainted with Memo Paris' adventurous spirit as you take a journey through our most emblematic perfumes. Delve into Memo Paris' universe. Our discovery set is your opportunity to experience new destinations through fragrances inspired by a desire for light and radiance.

title: AED 150 Voucher

title: Signature Duet Marfa
body:
Marfa, from skin to scent

The eau de parfum and the body lotion, one after the other. The lotion lays tuberose absolute on the skin and leaves it supple; the 75ml bottle then holds the gaze the way this white-hot Texan land does. A ritual that begins in the bathroom and lingers all evening.

title: Signature Duet Inlé
body:
Inlé, from skin to scent

The eau de parfum and the body lotion, one after the other. The lotion lays jasmine, mate and osmanthus on the skin and leaves it supple; the 75ml bottle then carries the same drift on fragrant waters through the day. A ritual that begins in the bathroom and lasts until nightfall.

title: Signature Duet Odéon x Odéon Rosebud
body:
Two faces of Odéon

This set brings together the two facets of the same Parisian district. In 75ml, Odéon unfolds its rose, tonka bean and patchouli, the fragrance of an evening at the theatre. In 30ml, Odéon Rosebud lifts the curtain on pink pepper, peony and white musk, lighter and made for daylight. One neighbourhood, two hours of the day.

title: Ithaque
body: Set off for Ithaca, that mythical island in the Ionian Sea, home to the epic tale of Ulysses and Penelope. An island of encounters at the heart of the archipelago, where the strength of cedar, vivacity of bergamot and sweetness of blackcurrant come together as one.

title: Palais Bourbon
body: Palais Bourbon, the Parisian home of the Assemblée Nationale, is made for unprecedented alliances. Behind its majestic pediment, the persuasive vanilla from Madagascar does not wield its power alone; it works with amber and oud as they develop their notes with warmth. Three parties occupy the benches, represented by spices, woods and balsams, and each brings its own touch and character to this olfactory assembly. A fragrance of contrast and cooperation, Palais Bourbon appeals with a unanimous show of hands: those that gladly hold the bottle and apply the fragrance.

title: African Rose
body:
When African Leather veiled in rose, an amazing interlude for a journey of renewed pleasure. Memo Paris journeys are not always long. During brief yet extraordinary stopovers, a fragrance can be dreamed up for a limited edition.

Inspired by the African continent, this fragrance unveils warm spicy notes of cardamom and saffron over a floral touch of geranium, which mingle with a leather accord to give life to an exceptional wild leather.

African Rose is a fragrance available exclusively online and in our Boutique Cambon at Paris.

title: Sky Paris Sky
body: Sky Paris Sky is a Memo Paris exclusive for Galeries Lafayette, paying homage to the dome of the famous Parisian department store. This magnificent Art Deco masterpiece, with its vanilla-coloured balconies, melts into a delicious cocoa butter. It reaches up to the Paris sky like a fleeting kiss of soft woods, and in its amber trail, the whole world is celebrated with warmth and generosity.

title: Darling Point X Thomas Lélu
body:
Darling Point has a date with Sydney for an unprecedented Australian encounter. The eau de parfum sets its course towards the bay and one neighbourhood in particular: that of a perfectly sweet pear, the fruit of intense new visions facing the Opera House. Accompanied by a luminous orange blossom and an elegant rose absolute, Darling Point offers a captivating backdrop, sculpted for infinite horizons.

Darling Point Limited Edition marks a collaboration between French artist Thomas Lélu and Memo Paris. Artist, writer and photographer, known for the maxims and mantras of his viral, striking and pop universe, he signs a bottle as generous and endearing as the fragrance itself.

title: Irish Leather
body: The wind, the moorland, the stride of the horses and their manes. Like a dance, they inspire you to bring a perfumed breeze to your body, invigorating and fresh.

title: Odéon
body: You applaud the majestic dome of the Panthéon and the city of light. You dream of jazz, novels, and patchouli. You will always love Paris.

title: Madurai
body: The vision of jasmine garlands returns to you, a radiant memory of India, their charm edged with their deeply moving blossoms. Your soft hands are delighted by their divine fragrance.

title: Inlé
body: Like the waves of Myanmar's lake, your hands, scented with osmanthus, feel light and airy. You feel as though you are drifting gently on a cloud.

title: Darling Point Essences Set
body:
This exclusive coffret contains a 75ml bottle of Darling Point eau de parfum along with six 30ml bottles, each capturing one of its key notes. It introduces a new gesture: applying your fragrance to the skin, then layering it with one of its own ingredients to further refine its character, in tune with your own desire. Choose from pear, rose, orange blossom, praline, cinnamon and saffron - the floral, gourmand or spicy facet that suits you best.

This singular sensory experience lets you live your Darling Point fragrance closer to your olfactory emotion, closer to your skin, to make it fully your own.

title: Our floral selection
body: A lasting sunlit memory. Cap Camarat unfolds in ylang-ylang, jasmine and Madagascan vanilla, softened by amyris, for a warm, radiant white-floral trail. Marfa captures desert nights through creamy tuberose absolute and Tunisian orange blossom. And the Lips candle, a nod to Marfa, blends hibiscus, coconut milk and a more sensual tuberose accord - a late-summer bouquet to carry into the new season.

title: The world of Odéon
body: The elegance of rose and patchouli runs through Odéon, where Isparta rose meets patchouli and tonka bean, and Eurus, a candle layered with pink pepper. Odéon Rosebud offers a lighter reinterpretation - rose absolute and pink pepper opening on to peony, freesia and a soft musk base, for a bright, theatrical trail into the new season.

title: Our intense sillages
body: African Leather draws on cardamom, geranium and a spicy leather accord for a memory-laden trail. Filage Amber essence layers vanilla, cinnamon bark and resinous cistus absolute into a warm, standalone signature - worn alone or woven into any fragrance. And Skiros, an Oud-based candle, blends olibanum, patchouli and oud for an earthy, enveloping warmth to close out the season.

title: Abu Dhabi Essences Set
body: This exclusive box, containing a 75ml bottle of Abu Dhabi perfume and six 30ml bottles, each featuring one of its key notes, inaugurates a new fragrance gesture for Memo Paris: that of being able to apply the signature fragrance to the skin together with an ingredient, chosen for its virtues. Date for generosity, vetiver for elegance, saffron for excellence, plum for joy, amber for creativity and cardamom for courage. This unique sensory experience gives the Abu Dhabi fragrance even greater intensity, fullness and refinement.

title: Essences Filages
body: This essence explores an iconic and unique note. A standalone ingredient. An emotion. Worn on its own, it reveals its unique character. Interwoven with another essence or combined with a Memo Paris fragrance, it allows you to create a special signature: your own olfactory fabric.

title: Sal de Menorca
body: Sal de Menorca pays tribute to a bird of rare beauty that has chosen the island of Minorca as its jewel box. Not far from the basins where precious salt rises to the surface, it appears. To celebrate the grace of the flamingo, the brilliance of bergamot and the delicacy of neroli entwine. A salted musk recalls the presence of the Mediterranean Sea, which embraces this island treasure.

title: French Leather
body: With its lime and rose essences and its suede accord evoking the inside of a handbag, this scent signs the adventure of a French rose, the one that makes your eyes shine. French Leather is a fragrance that hones the senses and awakens the Parisian spirit in everyone.

title: Irish Oud
body:
An extraordinary stopover that gives Irish Leather an ambery touch of Oud.

Like a nod to the Irish origins of Memo Paris' co-founder, his fragrance blends leather accord with the windy freshness of juniper berries and green mate absolute.

Irish Oud is a fragrance available exclusively online and in our Boutique Cambon at Paris.

title: Cap Camarat
body: A Provençal coastal treasure with untouched charm, a Mediterranean haven of beauty, Cap Camarat inspires a fragrance like a smile in the sun. Ylang-ylang, vanilla absolute and amyris essence unite, offering their sensual embrace. Benzoin, sandalwood and labdanum bestow their aura to this elegant composition, reminiscent of pine landscapes and rolling sea waves that lull and invite contemplation. A lighthouse keeps watch as the mind wanders, the body unwinds, surrendering to this jewel of the French Riviera.

title: Omnia Omnibus Ubique
body: This is the scent of an English institution, of a prestigious address, that of a grand department store whose motto is a Latin phrase: Omnia Omnibus Ubique. “Everything, for everyone, everywhere.” Welcome to Harrods. Here stands a grande dame to greet you, a royal ingredient, a delicately powdered iris butter. Within this temple of delights, a sumptuous floral oud guides you through floors and aisles, fulfilling your every desire. Enchanted by the ornamentation, the finely crafted details, the surrounding opulence, a creamy musk envelops you, you are captivated, aren’t you?

body: Rose and the Seine greet the return of bergamot. The magic of Odéon, its vibrant sky and mythical theatre, admires the epic journey of Ulysses nearing Ithaca, the long-awaited island, rediscovering the scents of his homeland: citrus, flowers, spices and woods. Two fragrances made for the stage.

title: Inlé X Odéon
body: From the golden roof of a sacred pagoda at the heart of Inlé Lake to the dome of the Panthéon overlooking Odéon, a cloud lingers and the air fills with perfume. Osmanthus, jasmine and maté absolutes above shimmering waters. Rose and tonka bean absolutes, patchouli essence in the Parisian sky.

title: Odéon
body:
In the heart of Paris, Memo Paris rediscovers a mythical district that always surprises. For this, ingredients we love to find again, such as rose, patchouli and tonka bean, are enlivened by a creative fire, thanks to the radiance of amber, fanned by candied date and sandalwood. A new light illuminates them: is it that of the stage of the theater that also bears the name Odéon, where the performance of each note and accord of the composition is applauded, or that which is reflected, at sunset, on the zinc roofs of the neighborhood, chosen as motifs for the Odéon flacon? Both, with elegance.

With this travel size, your perfume Odéon will follow you on all your scented journeys!

title: Abu Dhabi
body:
The Abu Dhabi fragrance, composed by perfumer Mylène Alran, has a guest of honor: the date. This tasty fruit, emblematic of the Al Aïn Oasis, an Emirati cultural and plant heritage, gives the fragrance its delicately generous, enveloping character. Abu Dhabi feels like the gentle undulation of a palm, and the caress of a fabric, that of Al Sadu, a traditional Bedouin weaving technique, which adorns the flacon.

With this travel size, your perfume Abu Dhabi will follow you on all your scented journeys!

title: Madurai
body:
A memory of India, steeped in the rich and airy fragrance of jasmine sambac and the creamier scent of sandalwood, is what guided the composition of Madurai. A fragrance that stirs the senses with vibrant notes of citrus and turmeric, like a colourful market stall.

With this travel size, your perfume Madurai will follow you on all your scented journeys!

title: Irish Leather
body:
Like a nod to the Irish origins of Memo Paris' co-founder, his fragrance blends leather accord with the windy freshness of juniper berries and green mate absolute.

With this travel size, your perfume Irish Leather will follow you on all your scented journeys!

title: Portobello Road
body:
That moment of brilliance that catches you after the rain, in the heart of a street full of life and shared moments. With its floral, zesty notes that recall the cheerful colors of its facades and flower market, Portobello Road offers a delicate interplay between the scents of nature, from rose to green leaves to clary sage, and the damp pavement, thanks to an original asphalt accord. Like a stroll through the city at its best.

Portobello Road is a fragrance available exclusively online and in our Boutiques.

title: Journey Book
body: Each composition invites you to discover ever more character and olfactory power, with leather accords reaching their peak. You will become acquainted with Memo Paris' adventurous spirit as you take a journey through our most emblematic perfumes. Delve into Memo Paris' universe. Our discovery set is your opportunity to experience new destinations through fragrances that seek intensity and depth.

title: Menorca
body: Menorca, early morning. The limewashed houses are still cool to the touch. Essence of bergamot. The ochre dry-stone walls shelter the memory of the island and that of a fragrance, essence of neroli. The Mediterranean waves cradle and invite a first swim beneath the rising rays, whose reflections make the bottle’s motif shimmer. They lead to the salt flats, a paradise of salt, plants and birds, vast tableaux shaped by salted musk. Art and life murmur everywhere, in the wild landscapes, in island gestures, in the trees and the lingering warmth. An evening of celebration awaits you.

title: Odéon Rosebud
body: In the heart of Paris, Memo Paris continues its exploration of Odéon, a district whose aura remains untouched. At its centre, a legendary theatre bearing its name becomes a place where anything is possible: three strikes of pink pepper, the velvet curtain with an apricot-soft touch rises to reveal the luminous appearance of rose and peony, floral heroines. A patchouli interlude leads to the final act, composed of a soft, enveloping white musk.

title: Ocean Leather
body: With Ocean Leather, Memo decides to leave the mainland to embark on a major destination, an infinitely blue one, the ocean, and sets off in search of a majestic cetacean, a mythical animal that has inspired literature and now the imagination of a perfume. Ocean Leather transports you in its current, its wake and its movement. An oceanic freshness given by Mandarin essence and Elemi essence meets the depths of marine Leather, Vetiver and Cedar essences.

title: Red Island
body:
It all begins with an aromatic top note, in which longoza, a typical herbaceous plant from the island of Madagascar, takes center stage, exhaling its unique, finely spiced charm. At its heart, a bold coffee extract unfolds, with its woody, toasty, smoky accents. The base note reveals the caressing facet of vanilla, another Malagasy jewel, adding a delicately gourmand touch to the composition.

About the flacon: it's called the traveller's tree and it adorns the bottle of Red Island.

The unique fan shape of this flowering plant punctuates the island’s landscapes and becomes the distinctive sign of this fragrance.

Red Island is a fragrance available exclusively online and in our Boutique Cambon at Paris.

title: Honey Dragon
body:
A long line of stars like a ribbon of fragrant honey. Like a fiery mythological creature unfolding in an ice-cold night. The constellation Draco is the inspiration for a composition of contrasting ingredients: the freshness of thyme and the vivacity of bergamot, teamed with the sensual warmth of vanilla and the ambery enchantment of myrrh and opoponax. Black pepper and cinnamon embody all the depth of a nocturnal apparition to imbue Honey Dragon with its intense and mysterious character.

Honey dragon is a fragrance available exclusively online, at Selfridges London, and at our Boutique Cambon in Paris.

title: Cap Camarat Essences Set
body: This exclusive gift set features a 75ml bottle of Cap Camarat and six 30ml bottles that each reprise one of its key notes. It marks a brand-new olfactory ritual for Memo Paris, which lets the wearer apply the signature scent to the skin along with an ingredient of their choice, further reinforcing the solar, warming aspect of the fragrance. Housed in their white case, voluptuous vanilla, ylang-ylang and musk assert their presence while patchouli, sandalwood and amyris are cloaked in a dark intensity. From light to shadow, like a day spent by Mediterranean shores, contemplate the course of the sun in all its delicious glow.

title: Ilha Do Mel
body: An enticing Brazilian island, allowing for all sorts of fantasies. Her name, Ilha do Mel or "Honey Island", immerses the soul in delicious dreams. This honey, which memories of love are made of, sends an urgent message: surrender to desire and lose yourself! It was its enchanting name that led Memo to this destination, a virtually untouched and pure island. Crests of broom absolute roll into noble Iris concrete, blending with voluptuous gardenia and orange blossom absolute... and a touch of jasmine blossom honey.

title: Boreas
body: Boreas follows the path of the arctic terns from north to south. To express this polar odyssey, the cool spice of cardamom merges with the soothing facet of Edenolide, a molecule that evokes musk and is enveloped in warm cedarwood.

title: Eurus
body: Calling to mind the flight of the white stork from France to Africa, the Eurus candle elegantly and seductively blends the vibrant kick of pink pepper, the delicate beauty of rose and the earthy depth of patchouli.

title: Neck Warmer
body:
This neck warmer, known in French as a ‘cache-nez’ (nose warmer), is a nod to our talented perfumers, also known as ‘noses’ - allows you to wear one of our signature fragrances close to your neck, while elegantly enjoying the beauty of the alpine landscape.

Rose slope, tonka bean slope, patchouli slope: get ready to head to the resort for a unique moment, your trail noticed in both the snow and the air, doubly rewarded.

title: Odéon X Madurai
body: A rose, a jasmine. Each finds room to bloom, and their dedicated fragrance celebrates their beauty. The Isparta rose absolute and Odéon’s candied-rose accord reveal a powdery, fruity, enveloping facet, while the jasmines of Madurai shine with a green, unique and warm intensity. Regal florals as a signature.

title: Ithaque X Inlé
body: From one shore to another, from the Ionian Sea to a lake in Myanmar, let yourself be carried by notes of jasmine absolute, cedarwood essence and bergamot. Their shared territory. Ithaque approaches, aromatic, fruity, woody, spicy, while Inlé reveals its floral nature, through a tea accord, maté absolute, cardamom essence and a fig accord.

title: French Leather X Inlé
body: French elegance meets a timeless lake and its floating gardens. Sovereign rose essence entwines with the softness of white flowers, osmanthus and jasmine absolutes. A suede accord converses with cedarwood essence. A cloud of tea drifts over the terrace of a Parisian café. Lime and maté, in a smile, a suspended moment.

title: Marfa

title: Ocean Leather
body: With Ocean Leather, Memo decides to leave the mainland to embark on a major destination, an infinitely blue one, the ocean, and sets off in search of a majestic cetacean, a mythical animal that has inspired literature and now the imagination of a perfume. Ocean Leather transports you in its current, its wake and its movement. An oceanic freshness given by Mandarin essence and Elemi essence meets the depths of marine Leather, Vetiver and Cedar essences.

title: Odéon
body:
In the heart of Paris, Memo Paris rediscovers a mythical district that always surprises. For this, ingredients we love to find again, such as rose, patchouli and tonka bean, are enlivened by a creative fire, thanks to the radiance of amber, fanned by candied date and sandalwood. A new light illuminates them: is it that of the stage of the theater that also bears the name Odéon, where the performance of each note and accord of the composition is applauded, or that which is reflected, at sunset, on the zinc roofs of the neighborhood, chosen as motifs for the Odéon flacon? Both, with elegance.

With this travel size, your perfume Odéon will follow you on all your scented journeys!

title: Odéon Essences Set
body:
This exclusive box, containing a 75ml bottle of Odéon perfume and six 30ml bottles, each featuring one of its key notes, inaugurates a new olfactory gesture for Memo Paris: that of being able to apply the signature fragrance to the skin by adding one of its own ingredients, chosen for its beauty, uniqueness and aura. Patchouli, Rose, Date, Musk, Amber and Tonka Bean combine to create a portrait of a timeless yet contemporary Parisian neighborhood.

This unique sensory experience gives Odéon fragrance even greater elegance, fullness and refinement.

title: Odéon X Jean Jullien
body: In the heart of Paris, Memo Paris rediscovers a mythical district that always surprises. For this, ingredients we love to find again, such as rose, patchouli and tonka bean, are enlivened by a creative fire, thanks to the radiance of amber, fanned by candied date and sandalwood. A new light illuminates them: is it that of the stage of the theater that also bears the name Odéon, where the performance of each note and accord of the composition is applauded, or that which emanates from the paintings and drawings of French artist Jean Jullien, invited for the occasion to give his interpretation of the fragrance? Both, elegantly.

title: Zante
body:
Oracles of freshness and sensual delight are leading us to Zante, as a citrus breeze gently carries us over a current of musk. If you are lucky, as you arrive from the Ionian Sea you may catch a glimpse of Navagio Beach lying in the shadow of an elegantly sprawling, languorous cliff. In the sky, the sun is as full and inviting as a bergamot. A musky cloud floats, tempering the mandarin orange fire. This is an eternal island for a solstice fragrance.

Zante is a fragrance available exclusively online and in our Boutique Cambon at Paris.

title: Portobello Road
body:
That moment of brilliance that catches you after the rain, in the heart of a street full of life and shared moments. With its floral, zesty notes that recall the cheerful colors of its facades and flower market, Portobello Road offers a delicate interplay between the scents of nature, from rose to green leaves to clary sage, and the damp pavement, thanks to an original asphalt accord. Like a stroll through the city at its best.

About the flacon: The Portobello Road motif was created by British artist Kate Daudy as an abstract vision, a colorful map seen from above her favorite London neighborhood. A collage of a busy street, of a city in motion.

Portobello Road is a fragrance available exclusively online and in our Boutiques.

title: Palais Bourbon
body: Palais Bourbon, the Parisian home of the Assemblée Nationale, is made for unprecedented alliances. Behind its majestic pediment, the persuasive vanilla from Madagascar does not wield its power alone; it works with amber and oud as they develop their notes with warmth. Three parties occupy the benches, represented by spices, woods and balsams, and each brings its own touch and character to this olfactory assembly. A fragrance of contrast and cooperation, Palais Bourbon appeals with a unanimous show of hands: those that gladly hold the bottle and apply the fragrance.

title: Candle Lid
body:
A touch of elegance for your Memo Paris candle.

Designed to preserve the fragrance and protect your candle, the MEMO PARIS Candle Lid is both a functional and aesthetic accessory. Crafted with care, it helps maintain the purity of the scent while adding a refined touch to your interior.

A delicate way to extend the journey of your candle.

title: Skiros
body: Skiros retraces the hummingbird’s journey from Mexico to the Rocky Mountains, blending the mystical facet of olibanum, the earthy touch of patchouli and the enchanting richness of oud, a wood beloved by Memo Paris for its resonance and depth.

title: Lips
body: Lips crosses the Pacific Ocean with the golden plover, from Alaska to Hawaii, bringing together delicate, floral hibiscus and a sunny, exotic accord of coconut milk, along with a warmer tuberose accord in a nod to the iconic Marfa fragrance.

title: Levante
body: Flying over the warm Mediterranean coast with the Cory’s shearwater, Levante opens with the resinous note of labdanum surrounded by vetiver and the signature of a refined leather accord, as a tribute to Memo Paris’s Cuirs Nomades fragrance collection.

title: Apeliotes
body: Inspired by the graceful flight of white swans as they journey from Korea to Japan, Apeliotes brings together zesty grapefruit, pure white tea and the woody embrace of cedarwood. It is the epitome of lightness and grace.

title: Abu Dhabi
body:
The Abu Dhabi fragrance has a guest of honor: the date. This tasty fruit, emblematic of the Al Aïn Oasis, an Emirati cultural and plant heritage, gives the fragrance its delicately generous, enveloping character, which is further enhanced by the presence of plum, amber, vetiver, saffron and cardamom.

About the flacon: Abu Dhabi’s flacon is inspired by Al-Sadu patterns, a traditional Bedouin technique of weaving.

title: Inlé
body: On Inlé Lake, in the heart of Myanmar, life is lived on the water. The view is unobstructed, sounds ricochet between the water and the sky, and come nightfall, the taste of silence is a rare, almost unknown delicacy. This is an eau de parfum that prolongs the dream of drifting on fragrant waters made of notes of Jasmine, Mate and Osmanthus.

title: Madurai
body:
A memory of India, steeped in the rich and airy fragrance of jasmine sambac and the creamier scent of sandalwood, is what guided the composition of Madurai. A fragrance that stirs the senses with vibrant notes of citrus and turmeric, like a colourful market stall.

About the flacon: the plate of Madurai is inspired by the hypnotic motifs that can be found on the ceiling of the temple.

title: Indian Leather
body:
This fragrance celebrates a majestic land, at once extravagant and delicate, and for this purpose, an opulent, imposing oud with controlled excess was chosen. Called the wood of the gods, it leads to a flamboyant, powerful leather accord with chiseled contours.

About the flacon: The Indian Leather design pays tribute to the elephant, which holds a special status in India. A sacred symbol of peace, mental strength and power, it is honoured by the beauty of its forms, which are at once imposing and graceful, supple and monumental.

title: Wild Scarf
body:
For this edition, Memo Paris celebrates its iconic fragrances by featuring the animals on each bottle. Fearless, elegant, powerful, proud, and free: they are the image of each fragrance. To accompany your favorite accord with even more panache.

This accessory can be worn many ways - around your neck, at the waist, as a headscarf or even on your bag.

title: Flåm
body: A fragrance that brings to mind the magnetic energy of the northern lights alongside the protective warmth of a cozy wooden house. The marriage of natural ingredients including bergamot, bitter orange, aromatic clary sage, and sambac jasmine creates a rush of bright freshness. They whirl around suave, vibrant notes of cedarwood. Then emerges that pleasant feeling of well-being at home, as Mother Earth generously provides ingredients such as tonka bean and vanilla pods, paired with comforting mineral amber and sweet white musk.

title: Corfu
body: A solar perfume, as vibrant as the Greek sky, leaving on the skin a warm trail, like a memory of a dive in the Ionian Sea. A modern chypre overdosed with musk. Opening with a tart rhubarb, bright bergamot and elegant blackcurrant, the fragrance evolves towards a soft and delicate bouquet of geranium, rose and lily of the valley, leaving on the skin a sophisticated musk facetted with notes of patchouli and moss.

title: Sicilian Leather
body: Sicilian Leather enables you to experience the freshness and liveliness of a leather accord. Solar, volcanic, invigorating: a composition carried by the sea winds, the island’s vegetation and the sovereign presence of Etna.

title: Argentina
body: With Argentina, Memo plunges into the heart of a territory, a country, to the rhythm of a dance, a passionate impulse. Argentina is embraced in its entirety, carried away in a single movement; that of a twirling tango. A dance of mixing, of travel, and on the dance floor, corolla shapes appear. Like a rose, emblematic of perfume, queen of flowers and symbol of ardent love. A floral aromatic with a sweet and warm back, wraps you in elegant and delicate way, where rose and oud meet to a tango dance.

title: Sintra
body: Sintra, reminiscent of a childhood with its marshmallow note brought by Orange blossom absolute, Petitgrain, Vanilla Madagascar absolute. Both mellow and airy, thanks to the presence of musks, it is very round, with a floral and fruity sweetness. Gourmet yet light, resolutely addictive.

title: Eau de Memo
body: L'Eau de Memo, which was created to celebrate the 10th anniversary of Memo Paris, encapsulates the spirit of the brand. On the perfume bottle, birds, symbol of travel and freedom, take flight from a sky that could be that of Paris, the cradle of Memo. The composition is unique and bears witness to an ongoing desire for creation. This fresh, intense and leathery eau de parfum is the result of a harmonious combination of green tea, jasmine absolute and leather.

title: Winter Palace
body: Winter Palace Eau de Parfum is a fresh and spicy scent that is a powerful contrast between fire and ice. Inspired by the hypnotic energy of China and its imperial palaces, the first impression is of fresh bergamot and oil of orange that bring a sheer and invigorating power.

title: Marfa
body: Marfa. A destination with a unique destiny. Its bottle emblazoned with a wide-open eye provides the first clue. Deep in the Texas, Marfa beckons the eye and holds its gaze. Marfa has a power of attraction like no other, like the tuberose Absolute: a bewitching, lingering, unforgettable flower. Marfa evokes the singular nature of this white-hot land.

title: Tamarindo
body: Tamarindo is nestled in lush wilderness, surrounded by turquoise waters beyond the primal forest and mountains. Giant tamarind trees are home to colourful parrots, their cries ringing through the jungle, the warm forest air made humid with forgotten scents. A round of captivating notes, a dizzying dance beneath the sun. Tamarindo is a well-guarded secret, a joyful landscape, a trail of happiness, a solar scent. Lose yourself, let the journey of this vagabond seed be your guide.

title: Ilha Do Mel
body: An enticing Brazilian island, allowing for all sorts of fantasies. Her name, Ilha do Mel or "Honey Island", immerses the soul in delicious dreams. This honey, which memories of love are made of, sends an urgent message: surrender to desire and lose yourself! It was its enchanting name that led Memo to this destination, a virtually untouched and pure island. Crests of broom absolute roll into noble Iris concrete, blending with voluptuous gardenia and orange blossom absolute... and a touch of jasmine blossom honey.

title: Kedu
body: Sesame and grapefruit come together and merge like the landscape that inspired them, the high plain of Kedu. Nestled on the island of Java, at the heart of Indonesia, this land is fertile, luxuriant and volcanic in one. The generosity of nature and the eruptive proximity of the Merapi volcano resound in echo, just like the promise of sesame and the burst of grapefruit answer one another. The same vitality, the same vigorous energy flows from one to the other, giving the composition all of its depth and breadth.

title: Italian Leather
body:
Italian Leather speaks the Italian of Rome, the one drowsily murmured in the seat of a cabriolet during an impromptu lovers' siesta. It teams the simplicity of green tomato leaf with the sophisticated beauty of leather, myrrh and vanilla absolute. A lucid dream.

With this travel size, your perfume Italian Leather will follow you on all your scented journeys!
